messages:
sam: heads up — billing bot just flagged a huge late-night transfer from s3:logs-apac -> s3:staging-uswest, ~$11.8k in one day :grimacing:
billing-bot: ALERT: Unusual data transfer detected — bucket=logs-apac, dest-region=us-west-2, estimate=$11798, triggered at 2026-02-14T02:12Z
 tara: yikes. any idea what pushed it? traces? model artifacts?
 sam: early signal points to trace replay job that mirrors debug-traces for nightly replays. noticed a bunch of gz files with names like trace-20260213-*.gz and sizes ~200MB each.
 leo: i pulled the transfer manifest from org-billing (query):
 ```sql
 SELECT dest_region, sum(bytes)/1024/1024/1024 as gb FROM transfers
 WHERE bucket = 'logs-apac' AND day = '2026-02-13' GROUP BY dest_region ORDER BY gb DESC;
 -- result: us-west-2 3500GB, eu-central-1 20GB
 ```
 irene: 3.5TB cross-region in one day is definitely the replay job. which job?
 sam: looks like trace-replay cron on namespace staging had TARGET_REGION=us-west-2 set by accident during a debug change on Feb 12. config snippet i found: 
 ```yaml
 jobs:
  - name: trace-mirror-nightly
    image: gcr.io/redwood/trace-replayer:sha256:abcd
    env:
      - name: TARGET_REGION
        value: "us-west-2"  # should be APAC
      - name: PREFIX
        value: "debug/"
 ```
 leo: that env was part of a temporary debug patch from @dev-sprint-12, it wasn't reverted.
 tara: can we stop it now? cost is still accumulating.
 infra-bot: Command received: scaling deployment trace-mirror-nightly -> 0 replicas (namespace: staging)
 infra-bot: kubectl command: `kubectl -n staging scale deploy/trace-mirror-nightly --replicas=0` (executed by sam)
 sam: done — job scaled to 0. stopped further copies.
 billing-bot: NOTE: mitigation will stop new egress but billing includes completed transfers; current invoice line remains. open ticket if you want adjustments.
 irene: good catch. next steps we should: 1) list all buckets with inter-region replication rules, 2) add guardrails to CI, 3) request a billing review with cloud sales for one-off credits, and 4) short-term archival/cleanup to reduce future replays.
 leo: i ran an s3-ls across our logging buckets and found a replication rule on logs-apac created Feb 11 by CI user `svc-ci` with condition prefix `debug/`.
 tara: can we add a policy to block cross-region replication for prefixes matching `debug/`?
 sam: yes — created RFC to clobber replication for debug prefixes and added a vault/secret policy to prevent accidental TARGET_REGION in k8s manifests. PR: https://git.redwood.dev/r/redwood/infra/+/4327
 irene: billing ask: please file a formal invoice dispute with cloud and include transfer manifest + timeline. i'll join the call with sales.
 leo: also propose longer-term changes:
 - move nightly replays to same-region S3 buckets and run replay workers in that region
 - enable stronger compression (we're storing gz but some payloads were uncompressed due to bug)
 - implement a pre-deploy terraform plan check that rejects non-local TARGET_REGION values for log-replay jobs
 tara: misc: is there any risk to Dedicated GPU pools from this? eg would artifact replication for models also use the same code path and accidentally move large checkpoints?
 sam: model checkout replication is a separate service but i'll audit it. if model artifacts are getting cross-region copied, that's a bigger cost.
 infra-bot: audit started: searching deployments with env TARGET_REGION != REGION and s3 replication rules with `debug/` prefix. results pending.
 irene: assigning action items: sam -> audit model artifact replication by EOD; leo -> gather transfer manifests and timeline; tara -> open billing dispute + collect cost owner approval. i'll schedule 1h with cloud sales tomorrow.
 sam: noted. quick mitigation summary: job stopped, PR merged to prevent regressions, audit in flight.
 tara: thanks all. we should also set up a cheap alert (monthly threshold) for any bucket that spikes >500GB/day cross-region.
 leo: added prom alert: `S3CrossRegionTransferBytesPerDay > 500 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024` for buckets tagged `logs` and `traces`.
 sam: and adding an item to infra runbook: how to pause replay jobs and request transient credits.
 irene: ok closing thread for now, will update after cloud meeting. :thumbsup:
